core.headline: Brook Hall: an Edwardian country house in the High Weald
core.summary: A detached Edwardian country house (1908) with five bedrooms, four receptions and approx. 4.5 acres including a three-acre paddock, heated outdoor pool and new oak-framed triple cart lodge with one-bedroom annexe.
core.listing:
Brook Hall stands on a gated plot of approx. 4.5 acres in the High Weald National Landscape, two miles from Frant station and four miles from Royal Tunbridge Wells. Built in 1908, the brick house rises under a clay-tiled roof with tile-hung upper elevations. The accommodation includes four reception rooms, five bedrooms and four bathrooms.

On the ground floor, the drawing room measures 7.10m x 5.20m and the dining room 5.40m x 4.60m. The kitchen/breakfast room runs to 8.20m x 4.90m. The principal bedroom measures 5.60m x 4.80m.

Outside, gardens and terrace adjoin the house. A heated outdoor pool is served by an air source heat pump. The three-acre paddock extends beyond. An oak-framed triple cart lodge, completed in 2025 under a recently granted planning permission, includes a one-bedroom annexe above. The gated drive provides parking for several cars.

Guide Price £2,100,000. Freehold. Council tax band H (Wealden District Council). EPC rating E. Brick with tile-hung upper elevations under a clay-tiled roof. Mains electricity. Mains water (not metered). Treatment plant. Oil-fired central heating. FTTC broadband. Mobile signal limited indoors; good outdoor coverage. Gated drive with parking for several cars; triple cart lodge. Building safety: none known. Restrictions: within the High Weald National Landscape. Rights and easements: public footpath crosses the southern edge of the paddock. Flooding: none known. Coastal erosion: none known. Planning: permission granted 2025 for the cart lodge with annexe above (built). Accessibility: none known. Coalfield/mining: none known. Known issues: council tax banding of the annexe has not been confirmed. Frant station approx. 2 miles (London Bridge approx. 1 hour); Royal Tunbridge Wells approx. 4 miles.
